import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Define Bhadla Solar Park geometry (approximate polygon)
bhadla_park = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[
    [71.90, 27.52], [71.95, 27.52], [71.95, 27.56], [71.90, 27.56], [71.90, 27.52]
]])

# 2. Date range for January 2022
start_date = '2022-01-01'
end_date = '2022-01-31'

# 3. Load Sentinel-2 surface reflectance collection
s2_col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') \
    .filterBounds(bhadla_park) \
    .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \
    .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 20))

# Check if collection is empty
if s2_col.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No Sentinel-2 images found for January 2022.")
    # Try Landsat 8 as fallback
    l8_col = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') \
        .filterBounds(bhadla_park) \
        .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \
        .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 20))
    
    if l8_col.size().getInfo() == 0:
        print("No Landsat 8 images found either.")
        print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    else:
        # Use Landsat 8
        print(f"Landsat 8 images: {l8_col.size().getInfo()}")
        image = l8_col.median().clip(bhadla_park)
        
        # Cloud masking for Landsat
        cloud_mask = image.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0)
        image = image.updateMask(cloud_mask)
        
        # Bands for Landsat: SR_B4 (Red), SR_B5 (NIR), SR_B6 (SWIR1)
        ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['SR_B5', 'SR_B4']).rename('NDVI')
        ndbi = image.normalizedDifference(['SR_B6', 'SR_B5']).rename('NDBI')
        
        # Classify solar panels: low vegetation, moderate built-up
        # Thresholds may need adjustment
        solar_mask = ndvi.lt(0.2).And(ndbi.gt(0.1))
        
        # Calculate area
        area_image = ee.Image.pixelArea().multiply(solar_mask)  # m²
        stats = area_image.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
            geometry=bhadla_park,
            scale=30,
            maxPixels=1e9
        )
        area_m2 = stats.get('area').getInfo()
        
        if area_m2 is None:
            print("Calculation failed.")
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        else:
            area_ha = area_m2 / 10000
            print(f"Solar panel area: {area_ha:.2f} hectares")
            if area_ha > 7000:
                print("<answer>A</answer>")
            else:
                print("<answer>B</answer>")
else:
    # Use Sentinel-2
    print(f"Sentinel-2 images: {s2_col.size().getInfo()}")
    image = s2_col.median().clip(bhadla_park)
    
    # Cloud masking for Sentinel-2
    qa = image.select('QA60')
    cloud_mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).eq(0).And(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 11).eq(0))
    image = image.updateMask(cloud_mask)
    
    # Compute indices
    ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI')
    ndbi = image.normalizedDifference(['B11', 'B8']).rename('NDBI')
    
    # Classify solar panels
    solar_mask = ndvi.lt(0.2).And(ndbi.gt(0.1))
    
    # Count valid pixels for classification mask
    count_stats = solar_mask.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=bhadla_park,
        scale=10,
        maxPixels=1e9
    )
    count = count_stats.get('NDVI').getInfo()
    
    if count == 0:
        print("No pixels classified as solar panels.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    else:
        # Calculate area
        area_image = ee.Image.pixelArea().multiply(solar_mask)  # m²
        stats = area_image.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
            geometry=bhadla_park,
            scale=10,
            maxPixels=1e9
        )
        area_m2 = stats.get('area').getInfo()
        
        if area_m2 is None:
            print("Area calculation failed.")
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        else:
            area_ha = area_m2 / 10000
            print(f"Solar panel area: {area_ha:.2f} hectares")
            print(f"Classified pixels: {count}")
            
            # Validate result range (sanity check)
            # Bhadla Solar Park total area is ~5,700 hectares
            # If calculated area > 20,000 ha, likely error
            if area_ha > 20000 or area_ha < 0:
                print("Unreasonable area value.")
                print("<answer>C3</answer>")
            elif area_ha > 7000:
                print("<answer>A</answer>")
            else:
                print("<answer>B</answer>")
